resampling: Compute physical axes from actual source and resized dimensions. Record upsampling explicitly; it cannot restore missing optical detail or establish an acquired microscope magnification. Native/ref working geometry must preserve the same physical field.
unknown_calibration: Retain source data in acquisition inventory, outside new Virchow2 inference and Bora benchmark scores. Never substitute numerical1.0micrometre spacing, estimate MPP from nuclei, or infer it from20x/40x alone.
optics: Record scanner/objective when reported. Objective, optical resolving power and pixel sampling are distinct; unavailable optical resolving power remains unknown.
history: Earlier signed cycles and caches remain historical. Unknown-calibration caches are not admitted into new cycles. A calibration correction requires a new input/cohort freeze and matched parent baselines. RGB conversion formulae remain unchanged.
